class: T4 diagnostic + bounded bit-exact local optimization
originating_constraint: Decode >=10 tok/s is the only reachable locked target (ADR-0003); the P40000 decode-step attribution (44842df) named the exact S>=65 values kernel as the primary attention lever

change.edit: #pragma unroll 4 -> #pragma unroll 8 on the serial position-ordered FMA loop
change.why_bit_exact: unrolling preserves the position-ordered FMA sequence (value = fmaf(prob[pos], bf16(V), value)); it only raises memory-level parallelism so the compiler prefetches more V loads ahead of the dependency chain. No FMA reorder, no shared memory, no split-KV.

claim_limits: This is a bit-exact local optimization returned through the real P40000/O16 API, not a new production route and not a target re-scope.

Decode is 4.82 tok/s at P40000, still below the 10 tok/s locked target. The remaining gap requires reducing KV bytes read (GQA-redundant V loads) or a bit-exact position-parallel values dataflow, both of which are larger architecture changes.
No speedup is claimed for prefill; prefill is unchanged and remains hardware-bound per ADR-0003.
